# Heading (one hash)
## Heading 2 (two hashes)
### Sub heading 3 (three hashes)
#### Sub heading 2 (four hashes)
##### Bold text (5 hashes)
###### Bold text 2 (6 hashes)
###### END

```{r}
air <- AirPassengers
air
# Hashes inside the r code are treated as comments and will be greyed out in the output
# In this code we have loaded the AirPassengers data
```

* Typing this way will give a bullet point in out output knitted file

```{r}
plot(air, main = "Air Passengers Plot")
```
